name: nist_fluid_properties
description: Density, specific volume, internal energy, enthalpy, entropy, Cv, Cp, speed of sound, Joule-Thomson coefficient, viscosity, thermal conductivity and phase (liquid/vapor/supercritical) for one of NIST's ~76 reference fluids (water, nitrogen, oxygen, argon, CO2, hydrocarbons, refrigerants...) at a given temperature and pressure. Every value carries its unit. Call nist_fluid_list first if unsure a fluid is covered.

fluid.description: Fluid name, formula or refrigerant code, e.g. "water", "CO2", "R134a", "nitrogen".

temperature.description: Temperature at which to evaluate properties.

pressure.description: Pressure at which to evaluate properties.

name: nist_fluid_saturation
description: Liquid/vapor saturation (phase-boundary) properties for one of NIST's ~76 reference fluids — give EITHER a saturation temperature (returns the matching saturation pressure, e.g. boiling point at 1 atm) OR a saturation pressure (returns the matching saturation temperature), plus density, enthalpy, entropy, viscosity, thermal conductivity and surface tension on both the liquid and vapor side of the boundary. Do not pass both temperature and pressure.

fluid.description: Fluid name, formula or refrigerant code, e.g. "water", "propane", "R134a".

temperature.description: Saturation temperature to evaluate. Omit if passing `pressure` instead.

pressure.description: Saturation pressure to evaluate. Omit if passing `temperature` instead.

name: nist_fluid_list
description: List the ~76 fluids NIST's Chemistry WebBook carries full thermophysical property surfaces for (water, nitrogen, oxygen, argon, CO2, light hydrocarbons, refrigerants R11-RC318, and a few industrial gases). Optionally filter by a substring of the name or refrigerant code.

query.description: Optional substring filter, e.g. "R1" or "propane". Omit to list all fluids.
